subject: SlatePoint private offer — purchase trajectory & buyflow playbook
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@slatepoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: SlatePoint private offer MAP & procurement timeline

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our conversation, attaching a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to accelerate the AWS private offer route for SlatePoint. High level:

- Goal: Private Offer (AWS) + 3-month ramp to reserved usage commitment.
- Key milestones: procurement signoff -> PO submission -> AWS private offer creation -> sandbox validation -> production cutover.
- Billing path: SlatePoint will be billed by Redwood via AWS private offer settlement (we provide PO and Customer Billing ID).

I attached a one-page MAP and a PO draft. Can you confirm: 1) who in procurement will own the PO? 2) any corporate billing constraints (multiple billing centers, PO number formats, or finance approval cadence)?

Proposed timeline (optimistic):
- Week 0: Legal review + Finance acknowledgement
- Week 1: Submit PO, sign private offer
- Week 2–3: Private offer provisioning + test account validation
- Week 4: Production rollout and billing transfer

I'll loop in Marissa (AM) to coordinate procurement steps and Karthik (SE) for the validation checklist.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: SlatePoint_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: PO_Draft_SlatePoint.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@slatepoint.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Anya Li <anya.li@slatepoint.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 17:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro: SlatePoint private offer MAP & procurement timeline

Rafael —

Thanks for the MAP and PO draft. A few quick clarifications from procurement: 

- We have two billing centers; they'd like the PO to show the finance center code (FC-231). Is that something you can accept on the PO?
- Do you require a blanket PO or can we submit a month-by-month committed spend PO that escalates after the ramp?
- Our legal will want to preview the private offer terms — do you have the AWS-facing statement of work / private offer guidance?

I cc'd Anya (Finance) — she will coordinate PO format. If you can share the step-by-step for the AWS private offer (who submits what to AWS, timing, and DocuSign flow), that'll speed things up.

Samir
Director, Procurement | SlatePoint Analytics
samir.patel@slatepoint.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@slatepoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: SlatePoint private offer MAP & procurement timeline

Samir —

Thanks — quick answers inline and a suggested minimal playbook below.

1) FC-231 on the PO is fine — we can accept that as the finance code.
2) Blanket vs month-by-month: we recommend a staged PO (month 1 commit + 2-month ramp) which lets you validate performance before full reserved commitment. We note the MAP reflects that staged approach.
3) AWS private offer guidance: attaching our internal AWS private offer checklist (aws_private_offer_guidelines.pdf). High level:
   - Redwood prepares the private offer in the AWS Marketplace Partner Portal once PO is received and finance details confirmed.
   - AWS issues the private offer URL and contract; your legal signs via DocuSign.
   - Once AWS confirms the private offer, billing is routed through AWS Marketplace to Redwood per the private offer settlement.

Playbook (minimal):
- Day 0: Procurement confirms PO (with FC-231) and emails PO to redwood-sales@redwood-inference.com
- Day 1–2: Redwood validates PO + creates private offer request with AWS; we send DocuSign to SlatePoint legal + ops
- Day 3–7: AWS finalizes private offer -> test provisioning (Karthik runs smoke validation)
- Day 8–14: Production cutover and billing commences

Attaching the MAP and the AWS private offer checklist. Marissa will coordinate legal redlines and the DocuSign envelope.

Rafael

[Attachment: aws_private_offer_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: SlatePoint MAP — legal redlines and DocuSign flow

Rafael / Karthik —

I reviewed the PO draft and redlines from legal. Key items to flag for AWS private offer flow:

- Legal requests an abbreviated liability clause specific to Marketplace settlements (I attached a redline PDF).
- Finance requires the invoice schedule to reference the FC-231 code and include a single consolidated monthly invoice.
- Procurement prefers the DocuSign envelope to route: Anya (Finance) -> Samir (Procurement) -> SlatePoint Legal.

Action items I propose:
- Rafael: submit finalized PO (with FC-231) to redwood-sales@redwood-inference.com by EOD Monday (Oct 4).
- Karthik: prepare the smoke-test checklist and a sandbox endpoint for SlatePoint's infra team.
- Legal (cc'ed on the HubSpot thread) to confirm the abbreviated liability language or propose a redline.

HubSpot link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/7843 (I added tasks and set a 10/11 close target).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

[Attachment: PO_Draft_SlatePoint_redline.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Anya Li <anya.li@slatepoint.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@slatepoint.com>, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SlatePoint private offer — purchase trajectory & buyflow playbook

Rafael / Marissa —

Confirming intent to proceed. Procurement has drafted the PO with FC-231 and our legal is OK with the abbreviated liability clause pending one minor edit (we'll send through DocuSign).

Next steps from our side:
- You'll receive the signed PO via DocuSign by EOD 10/04.
- Please share the private offer request template you submit to AWS so our ops team can map the entitlement IDs.

Thanks for the clear MAP — this timeline works for us. Looking forward to Karthik's sandbox link.

Best,
Anya Li
Head of Finance Operations | SlatePoint Analytics
anya.li@slatepoint.com
